title: Add structured logging for failed payments
intent: Add structured logging for failed payments without exposing sensitive information.
acceptance_criteria: A failed payment attempt (timeout or decline) logs a structured event via utils/logging.py
Logged fields never include raw provider exception internals beyond what redact() already allows
expected_risks: get_logger and redact already exist and work (utils/logging.py) — this is a wiring change, not new logging infrastructure
Logging the wrong field (e.g. a future card/token field) would defeat the purpose of redact()
expected_tests: a failed payment emits a structured log entry
the logged entry does not contain unredacted sensitive fields
expected_failure_modes: PaymentService never calls get_logger/redact on the failure path (current gap)
